# Siddh Sai Corporation

Siddh Sai Corporation is a Surat, Gujarat based construction, renovation, waterproofing, painting and civil infrastructure company established in 1993.

Business location: 4th Floor, Homeland City, 408-413, University Rd, opp. J.H Ambani School, Piplod, Surat, Gujarat 395007, India
